items.title: How a GE divestiture changed Hyliion’s future
items.summary: Hyliion founder and CEO Thomas Healy shares how co-developing tech with GE, plus perfect timing during the industrial giant’s KARNO divestiture, turned into an opportunity for a small startup to make an acquisition that few believed could ever happen.

items.title: Wall Street Analysts See GE (GE) as a Buy: Should You Invest?
items.summary: Based on the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), GE (GE) should be added to one's portfolio. Wall Street analysts' overly optimistic recommendations cast doubt on the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric. So, is the stock worth buying?

items.title: GE Aerospace (GE) Just Overtook the 50-Day Moving Average

items.title: Hyliion's founder turned an EV downturn into an energy power play
items.summary: Hyliion founder and CEO Thomas Healy took his EV truck company public, watched the industry collapse, and rebuilt it into a power generation business that bought a division from GE and works with the United States Navy. He joins host Elizabeth Gore to talk about the pivot, the coming AI-fueled energy crisis, using 3D printers to build a new kind of power plant, and more.

items.title: GE Aerospace defense unit chief Amy Gowder to step down
items.summary: Nov 23 () - US jet-engine maker GE Aerospace said on Monday Amy Gowder, ‌president and CEO of its defense ‌and systems business, will leave the company, while ​Darin DiTommaso, the unit's vice president of engineering, assumes the role on an interim basis. • Gowder will leave in the first ‌quarter of 2027 ⁠to pursue external opportunities • The company is conducting an internal and ⁠external search for her successor • Gowder joined GE Aerospace in 2022 after serving in ​several executive ​roles

items.title: New CFO Appointment Could Be A Key Moment For Victrex (LSE:VCT)
items.summary: Victrex has appointed Adam Butcher as Chief Financial Officer and Executive Director, effective 15 February 2027, following an internal and external search to replace the interim finance chief. Butcher’s background in financial planning, M&A, restructuring and business transformation at Honeywell, Rolls-Royce, General Electric, Baker Hughes and Wood Group aligns closely with Victrex’s focus on operational change, cost efficiency and long term value creation.
